scene.title: DNA Replication Overview
scene.summary: Helicase unwinds DNA, polymerase builds a new strand, and ligase joins fragments, producing two identical DNA molecules.

beats.title: Helicase opens the fork
beats.narration: Helicase binds to the DNA and unwinds the double helix, creating a replication fork.
